settled-x402 0.5.0: check x402 endpoints against Settled before paying

Usage:
  npx settled-x402 check <url> [--network <name>] [--post] [--json] [--pass <token>]
      Read the endpoint's 402 quote (nothing is paid) and ask Settled about it.
      --network picks the option you would pay on (default: the network Settled has on record).
      Exit code: 0 pay, 2 caution, 3 avoid, 4 unknown, 1 usage or internal error.
  npx settled-x402 spend [--budget-file <path>]
      Today's tally from the spend ledger a guard with dailyBudgetUsd keeps (default: SETTLED_BUDGET_FILE,
      else ~/.settled-x402/spend.json): what the guard let through, per call, with each call's loot rarity.
  npx settled-x402 mcp [--pass <token>]
      Run Settled's MCP server over stdio, for Claude Desktop, Cursor and other stdio clients.
  npx settled-x402 skill [install] [--global | --to <dir>]
      The settled-x402 Agent Skill (SKILL.md, references/, scripts/): the same rules as this guard,
      for agents that read skills instead of calling code. 'skill' prints where the files are;
      'skill show' prints SKILL.md; 'skill install' copies the folder into this project's
      .claude/skills/ (Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK read it from there), into
      ~/.claude/skills/ with --global, or into any folder with --to <dir>.
  npx settled-x402 --version

Environment: SETTLED_PASS (a Settled day pass), SETTLED_BASE_URL, SETTLED_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS=1.
Docs: https://settled.tools/for-agents
